high_level_description: This image showcases a meal setup with a focus on a dish of butter chicken served alongside a bowl of white rice. The butter chicken is presented in a round, black ceramic dish with a blue handle, filled with a rich, creamy orange sauce containing chunks of cooked chicken and garnished with chopped herbs. The rice is served in a metallic bowl placed to the side. The setting appears to be a cozy, indoor dining area with a wooden table as the surface for the meal. There are some utensils, including a fork and a spoon, neatly arranged on a dark blue napkin beside the rice bowl.
